## How to watch the iPhone 18 event

Apple's event kicks off Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. PT / 1:00 p.m. ET at the Steve Jobs Theater at Apple Park, with a livestream on Apple's website and YouTube channel for those not attending in person.

Mashable will be there on the ground, so look out for our coverage and hands-on impressions once the keynote wraps.

results.content: The iPhone 18 Pro Max should carry the same core upgrades as its smaller sibling, scaled up to fit the larger 6.9-inch form factor. Expect the same shrunken Dynamic Island, the same A20 Pro chip on TSMC’s 2nm node running iOS 27, and the same C2 modem with expanded satellite internet as the iPhone 18 Pro. [...] Like every year, the new iPhones will ship with stable iOS 27 builds and deeper Apple Intelligence integration, including the new Siri AI experience, new editing features in Photos, and a couple of other new features.
